author: Komorebi P.

scope.system: eight-state two-generator learned linear operator workspace
scope.primary_question: Does the finite hard or soft causal quotient stabilize jointly over exact reachable-history and continuation horizons, and where do repeated identity paths first falsify that completion?
scope.reason_not_held_out: Fresh coordinate resamples are drawn from the finite D4 table-pair family reconstructed as covered by checkpoint training support.
known_before_freeze: v0.2.1 found an exact hard-decision quotient on its ordinary depth-6, suffix-H3 window
v0.2.1 found nonzero probability and centered-logit microstate variation
v0.2.1 found repeat-16 identity-path angular drift and continuation-visible hard errors
v0.2.1 failed its full positive-ray tangent contraction gate
the registered projective checkpoints shrink radially before normalization

execution.invalid_policy: Any norm at or below the minimum or any nonfinite state, norm, logit, probability, or statistic fails execution; no silent clipping or imputation.
execution.slot_conversion: Every canonical word is mapped through the episode-specific canonical_to_slot array before learned execution.
execution.episode_isolation: Signature identities, quotient classes, and soft groups are computed within each episode; integer signature IDs are never compared across episodes.
execution.runner_freeze_rule: Freeze runner and test digests after structural validation and before inspecting learned endpoints. Preserve any invalid first run and issue a documented adaptive revision rather than silently overwriting it.

episodes.training_support_warning: Fresh episode seeds do not imply held-out table-pair support.

completion_surface.history_domain: all canonical binary histories of every length <= L, for all starts
completion_surface.future_domain: all canonical binary suffixes of every length <= H
diagnostic_views: exact history shell =L with cumulative suffixes <=H
cumulative histories <=L with exact suffix shell =H
exact history shell =L with exact suffix shell =H

hard_interface.prediction: argmax decoder logit, with strictly positive target margin required to reject ties

recursive_signature.ordering: canonical R child before canonical F child
recursive_signature.identity_mechanism: exact integer tuple equality or tuple interning with equality resolution; hash digests alone forbidden
recursive_signature.scope: intern tables and IDs are episode- and horizon-local

hard_interface.rectangle_aggregation: all 81 cumulative cells and both seeds must pass
hard_interface.downset_requirement: The cumulative pass mask must be a down-set; a failure cannot be followed by a pass at greater-or-equal L and H. Violation is an implementation/audit failure.

soft_interfaces.probability: breadth-first concatenation of softmax probability vectors for all suffixes <=H
soft_interfaces.centered_logit: breadth-first concatenation of C logits for all suffixes <=H, C = I - 11^T/8
soft_interfaces.grouping: within current exact semantic label and within episode
soft_interfaces.centered_logit_exact_tolerance: 1e-10 * max(1, maximum absolute centered logit in the declared cell)
soft_interfaces.exact_soft_collapse_gate: Both maximum coordinate ranges must meet their numerical-identity tolerances in every episode and every cumulative cell.
soft_interfaces.rms_policy: RMS dispersion is descriptive; no post-hoc approximate-stability cutoff is permitted.
soft_interfaces.separation_rule: Soft dispersion never changes hard signature class counts or the hard completion verdict.

diagonal_action.criterion: For every episode, source signature class, and generator, all class members induce one target signature and its semantic label equals the exact episode D4 action.
diagonal_action.same_space_caveat: Passing diagonal compatibility does not establish an endomorphism on a stabilized Q_(L,H), an invariant metric, or indefinite recurrence.

relator_witness.suffix_enumeration: all canonical words through each H
relator_witness.ground_truth_precondition: Every repeated registered relation has exact identity D4 action.

matched_nonidentity_control.construction: For v = relation^repeat, retain v[:-1] and toggle only the final canonical generator.
matched_nonidentity_control.precondition: Exact D4 action of every control word is nonidentity; otherwise stop execution.
matched_nonidentity_control.interpretation: Deterministic length/path-prefix sanity comparator, not an iid control or causal estimate.

reported_endpoints: identity-loop versus baseline hard continuation survival
loop and baseline semantic continuation accuracy
minimum target margin and loop-minus-baseline change
positive-ray endpoint L2 distance and angle with negative rays distinct
paired probability signature RMS and maximum difference
paired centered-logit signature RMS and maximum difference
matched-control semantic accuracy and margin against its own exact target
relator_witness.hard_closure_gate: Every identity insertion has hard survival 1.0, semantic accuracy 1.0, strictly positive margins, and zero invalid events for every suffix through H=8.

soft_path_flatness_gate.maximum_centered_logit_difference: 1e-10 * max(1, maximum absolute centered logit in the paired comparison)
soft_path_flatness_gate.coverage: every relation, budget, base case, episode, seed, and suffix through H=8

relator_witness.control_gate: Every control has verified nonidentity ground truth, exact semantic continuation accuracy through H=8, positive margins, zero invalid events, and endpoint prediction different from baseline in every case.
relator_witness.falsification_rule: One identity-loop hard disagreement is a counterexample to unconditional completion at that observed history depth and horizon.
relator_witness.pass_limit: Passing this relation family does not certify all ordinary histories of the same total depth.

registered_gates.E0_execution_integrity: Exact checkpoint digests, restricted loading, counts, canonical-slot conversion, tuple recursion, numerical validity, structural tests, and frozen runner digest.
registered_gates.H0_hard_rectangle: Every cumulative cell for both seeds and all episodes meets the hard completion rule.
registered_gates.H1_downset: Cumulative hard pass mask is a down-set.
registered_gates.S0_soft_exact_collapse: Probability and centered-logit coordinate ranges meet their exact tolerances in every cumulative cell.
registered_gates.D0_diagonal_action: Every registered diagonal action is well-defined and equals the exact D4 action.
registered_gates.W0_relator_hard_closure: Every registered identity insertion remains exactly correct through H=8 with positive margin.
registered_gates.W1_relator_soft_flatness: Every registered identity insertion meets ray, probability, and centered-logit identity tolerances.
registered_gates.C0_nonidentity_control: Every matched nonidentity path remains exactly task-correct and distinguishable from baseline.

structural_validation: vectorized trajectory tree equals scalar recurrence
recursive hard signatures equal explicit suffix tuples through at least H=3
history, suffix, and decision count formulas are exact
handcrafted coherent, split, merge, and wrong-but-coherent cases are classified correctly
canonical_to_slot generator swaps preserve exact semantics
zero and nonfinite states fail closed
positive and negative rays are not identified
inherited v0.2.1 L6-H3 ordinary hard result regresses separately from fresh v0.3.0 endpoints

aggregation.gate_rule: worst-case conjunction over cases, episodes, and seeds
aggregation.reason: Two fixed checkpoint seeds and deterministic exhaustive finite domains do not support population-level inference.

claim_rules.finite_rectangle_only: A hard pass supports only the exact registered L,H<=8 histories, suffixes, episodes, and checkpoints.
claim_rules.hard_soft_separation: Hard quotient identity does not imply equality of probabilities, centered logits, or full future laws.
claim_rules.diagonal_not_closed: The audited action naturally changes both indices; no same-space quotient action is claimed without stabilization.
claim_rules.relator_asymmetry: A relator failure falsifies an unconditional completion claim at that witness; a pass does not prove exhaustive ordinary behavior at that depth.
claim_rules.control_limit: The matched nonidentity word is a deterministic sanity comparator, not an independent experimental population.
claim_rules.relation_redundancy: frfr and rfrf are distinct learned paths but algebraically redundant, not independent hypotheses.
claim_rules.fresh_not_heldout: Post-training coordinate resamples are not held-out table-pair support.
claim_rules.normal_attraction_excluded: No vertical semantic fiber is identified and no normal-attraction certificate is claimed.
universal_exclusions: spontaneous Neuralese in frontier language models

required_outputs: per-seed and per-episode cumulative completion surface
exact history and future shell diagnostics
hard split, merge, correctness, class, completion, and margin metrics
separate probability and centered-logit dispersion metrics
individual gate verdicts without an omnibus relaxation
runner, tests, and their SHA-256 digests
